# Gelabber v0.7.1

Integrated through the PRs #280-#285, #292, #300-#303 into `v0.7.1` and the
version PR into `main`.

**Operators: read "Upgrade notes" first.** Three database migrations run on
the first start (no rollback without a backup). Account mail stays off until
you configure an SMTP relay.

## Accounts

- Address confirmation and password reset by mail (#284). Off until the
  operator sets `SMTP_HOST`; until then registration works as before.
  - With mail on, registration sends a confirmation link (valid 24 h) and
    signs nobody in. Confirming asks for the account's password as well.
  - "Passwort vergessen?" on the sign-in page sends a reset link (valid 1 h,
    single use). A reset ends every session of the account.
  - Registration answers the same whether or not an address is known, and
    at most 5 mails per address and hour go out.

## Notifications

- New switch **"Inhalt in Benachrichtigungen verbergen"** in the
  notification settings (#280). Web Push and the page's own notifications
  then only say "Neue Nachricht von …", without text or conversation. It
  applies to every device of the account; notifications already on screen
  are closed when it is turned on.
- Mention follow-ups (#283): `@here` inside a link no longer pings, an edit
  that keeps `@here` reaches the same people as before, the unread mention
  count is faster, and a brand-new conversation follows its own and its
  server's notification setting right away.
- Read sync and Web Push follow-ups (#282): "mark everything as read" no
  longer fails when a channel is deleted at the same moment, mention pushes
  only go to people still in the server, and subscriptions a push service
  refuses are cleaned up without dropping everything on a server-side fault.

## Calls

- **Push-to-talk** (#285): voice settings offer "Sprachaktivierung" or
  "Push-to-Talk" with any key or side mouse button and a release delay. In
  the browser the key works while the tab has the focus. The desktop app
  hears it globally during a call: on Windows through a keyboard/mouse hook,
  on Linux through the GlobalShortcuts portal (KDE and GNOME ask once; on
  Hyprland bind `gelabber-desktop:push-to-talk` in `hyprland.conf`).
- Desktop app: playback above 100 % is limited after the mix instead of
  clipping each loud speaker (#281).

## Video codecs

- The media server tells every client which video codecs all receivers in
  the room can decode, and a publisher picks the best of them: H.264 where
  the device encodes it in hardware, otherwise VP8 (#292). Rooms with a
  receiver that cannot decode H.264 stay on VP8.
- Desktop app, Linux: H.264 decoding on the GPU through the system's
  GStreamer (NVIDIA, VA-API), with a software fallback (#300).
- Desktop app, Windows: H.264 through Media Foundation (NVENC, AMF,
  Quick Sync, else Microsoft's encoder; DXVA decoding) (#301). Windows N
  without the Media Feature Pack stays on VP8.
- The desktop packages no longer ship an H.264 codec of their own (#302):
  H.264 comes only from the system (GStreamer on Linux, Media Foundation on
  Windows). Without a system codec, calls use VP8. The third-party notices no
  longer list FFmpeg and OpenH264.

## Build

- CI: pull requests no longer evict the shared Rust and Docker caches, and
  the Linux desktop job stops building the mediasoup worker twice (#303).

## Upgrade notes

- **Back up first** (`deploy/backup.sh`) or pause Watchtower: migrations
  0020 (notification privacy), 0021 (account mail: `email_verified_at`,
  `registration_pending`, `account_tokens`; existing accounts count as
  confirmed) and 0023 (`messages.here_users` and a partial index on
  messages; message writes wait while the index builds) run on start.
- **Account mail** stays off until you set, in `.env`:

  ```bash
  SMTP_HOST=smtp.example.org
  SMTP_SECURITY=starttls        # starttls (587, default), tls (465) or none (25)
  SMTP_PORT=                    # only if not the default for SMTP_SECURITY
  SMTP_USERNAME=…               # both or neither
  SMTP_PASSWORD=…
  MAIL_FROM="Gelabber <noreply@example.org>"
  APP_PUBLIC_URL=https://chat.example.org
  ```

  Take the new `compose.yaml`, which passes these through. The API refuses to
  start with a password over `none`, without `MAIL_FROM` or
  `APP_PUBLIC_URL`, or with an `http://` public URL while
  `API_COOKIE_SECURE=true`. Mail links point at `APP_PUBLIC_URL`. See
  `deploy/README.md`.
- **Desktop, Linux (Arch):** new optional dependencies for H.264 from the
  system: `gst-plugins-bad` (h264parse, NVIDIA), `gst-plugin-va` (Intel/AMD)
  and `gst-libav` (software decoding). Without them calls use VP8.
- **Desktop, Windows:** the installer and `latest.json` are attached to this
  release; 0.7.0 apps offer the update.

## Open

- Not tested on physical devices: push-to-talk with real keyboards and mice
  on Windows, KDE, GNOME and Hyprland; echo cancellation with speakers above
  100 % in the desktop app; hardware H.264 encoding and decoding (NVIDIA,
  AMD, Intel) and the CPU load in a real call; mail delivery through a real
  relay.
- Open issues: #165 (desktop tracker), #195 (rest: session lifetime).
